svg.text: Side-by-side: the same Directives obligations, two ways of working
Directives activity (stage codes)
OSD-native lane (default since 2025)
Git-native lane (exemption — Metanorma + commenter)
P-members vote 3 months
e-Form 4 in OSD; ballot auto-generated
on submission; voting inside OSD.
NP submitted to secretariat per ISO forms;
ballot is external — GitHub only tracks the outcome
as a milestone.
WD drafting (20.00→20.20)
WG consensus, no ballot
Collaborative XML editor (NISO STS) in OSD;
real-time multi-author drafting; Word/PDF import.
Metanorma AsciiDoc source in Git; dataset-driven
tables; CI renders PDF/DOC/STS XML per commit;
published editions frozen in the same repo.
CD consultation + ballot (30.x→30.99)
Committee consensus required
Online commenting during the CD consultation;
comments auto-collated; resolution status per
comment; CD ballot attached automatically.
Comments arrive as DOCX/XLSX sheets → commenter
import → issues; dispositions as commits on the
document PR; sheet regenerated by export.
DIS ballot (40.00→40.92)
All national bodies, 12 weeks
Ballot in OSD (Option A commenting by members);
comments and votes collected in the platform;
40.92 report generated from OSD data.
Ballot via ISO CS; comments imported as issues;
every disposition a commit; the 40.92 full report
is the exported disposition sheet.
Disposition of comments (after each ballot)
Project editor records consensus per comment
Resolution recorded against each comment in OSD;
status (accepted / rejected / noted) visible to all;
exportable as the disposition report.
Disposition = issue comment (retrieved into YAML
observations) + the commit that changed the source;
export → shaded ISO comment sheet DOCX.
Yes/no, 2 months
Vote in OSD; no comments permitted at FDIS.
Vote via ISO CS; no comments — GitHub ledger
is already final; release tagging prepared.
Publication (60.00→60.60)
ISO CS publishes; STS delivered to ISO
OSD document is publication-ready XML;
flows to ISO CS for publication.
Metanorma STS XML + PDF submitted through the
secretariat; release tagged in the repository.
Systematic review (5 years after 60.60)
Confirm / amend / revise / withdraw
SR ballot handled per ISO procedures
(OSD covers new/revision projects).
SR comments imported as issues; a "revise" outcome
starts the next cycle: new edition branches created
from the frozen published block.
Both lanes satisfy the same Directives obligations; they differ only in the ledger (OSD project vs Git repository) and the tooling.
The bridges in diagram 03 keep the two ledgers consistent when a project moves between lanes.
